4. [speaker: either] その本、どう？いくら？ | Reading: そのほん、どう？いくら？ | Romaji: sono hon, dou? ikura? | English: How about that book? How much is it? | Cue: Ask your friend how much that book costs.
5. [speaker: either] 電車で行くのはどう？ | Reading: でんしゃでいくのはどう？ | Romaji: densha de iku no wa dou? | English: How about going by train? | Cue: Suggest going by train.
